scope: Eight questionable provisional men products across S136, S140, S142, S145 and S146 checked at full 1350x1800 source resolution
boardTitle: Eight Casual cores · full-source correction audit
boardNote: Three Luxury scenario holds revoked · four catalog products rejected · one controlled jean retained · no outfit approval or UI integration

entries.label: Apricot Zip-Neck Knit Tank
entries.reason: The clean texture and color can work at Mid-Range, but the long rectangular body, basic exposed zipper and simple rib finishing do not carry a Luxury scenario. Remove the S136 hold and leave it unassigned for a lower tier.

entries.label: Apricot Contrast-Trim Knit Shirt
entries.reason: The regular body, warm color and chevron texture are usable, but the white piping, ordinary buttons and basic knit finishing read Mid-Range Zara rather than Luxury. Remove the S140 hold and keep it available for a lower tier.

entries.label: Light-Sage Technical Casual Short
entries.reason: The controlled above-knee line is acceptable, but the synthetic surface, curved technical thigh seams and ordinary fly construction read Casual or Travel, not Luxury. Remove it from S140 and retain only as a lower-tier possibility.

entries.label: Lavender Ribbed Half-Zip
entries.reason: The full view contradicts the earlier board judgment: shoulders are strongly dropped, sleeves are broad, and the body hangs long over the hips. It recreates the oversized-top problem and leaves the accepted catalog.

entries.label: Blue-Gray Washed Straight Jean
entries.reason: The jean has controlled thigh ease and a straight ankle without pooling. Keep it as S142's only hold, but style it uncuffed with a regular-length colorful knit and low-profile shoe so the outfit does not become bulky or streetwear-heavy.

entries.label: Lavender Button-Neck Sweatshirt
entries.reason: The washed fleece, tall button stand, chunky pale buttons and loose sleeve stacking read dated basic sportswear rather than modern Zara taste. The cheerful color cannot rescue the construction; remove it from the accepted catalog.

entries.label: Dark-Navy Faded Jean
entries.reason: The thigh and knee are visibly narrow, the dark whisker fade and orange stitching look dated, and the hem sits heavily on the shoe. It is not the clean controlled-straight denim required for the rebuild.

entries.label: Peacock-Blue Waffle Half-Zip Hoodie
entries.reason: The full source proves a deeply dropped shoulder, broad sleeves, large pouch and long rounded body. It is exactly the oversized hoodie proportion the user rejected, so the strong color does not justify keeping it.
